# LINE

Read and answer LINE Official Account chats, send broadcasts and run automations through the Zernio API

import { PlatformCapabilities } from '@/components/platform-capabilities';

Connect your own LINE Official Account through its Messaging API channel. Chats land in the [inbox](/messages/list-inbox-conversations) next to WhatsApp, iMessage and your social DMs.

## Quick reference

<PlatformCapabilities rows={[
  { property: 'Account', value: 'Your LINE Official Account, with a Messaging API channel' },
  { property: 'Connect', value: 'Channel ID and Channel secret; Zernio sets the webhook URL' },

## Before you start

You need a LINE Official Account with the Messaging API enabled in [LINE Official Account Manager](https://manager.line.biz/) (Settings > Messaging API).

## Connect

Send the Channel ID and Channel secret to `POST /v1/connect/line/credentials`. Then turn on Webhooks and turn off auto-response in LINE Official Account Manager. [Connect](/platforms/line/connect) has every step.

## Common errors

- **Wrong Channel ID or secret**: the connect call returns `400`. Copy both again from the channel's Basic settings tab.
- **No messages arrive**: Webhooks is off in LINE Official Account Manager > Settings > Response settings.
- **Replies are rejected**: the account's monthly message quota is used up. Raise it in LINE Official Account Manager.
